definition_en: The ability to perceive, interpret, and respond to sensory information such as visual, auditory, tactile, or olfactory stimuli in the work environment.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk mengesan, mentafsir dan bertindak balas terhadap maklumat deria seperti rangsangan visual, auditori, sentuhan atau bau dalam persekitaran kerja.
typical_tasks_en:
• Detect colour variations in fabric dye lots before production approval.
• Identify abnormal sounds from a production machine during routine checks.
• Feel for surface defects on ceramic tiles during inspection.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Kesan variasi warna dalam lot pewarna fabrik sebelum kelulusan pengeluaran.
• Kenal pasti bunyi tidak normal daripada mesin pengeluaran semasa pemeriksaan rutin.
• Rasa kecacatan permukaan pada jubin seramik semasa pemeriksaan.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires detecting visual details or colour differences
• The task involves distinguishing sounds, tones, or auditory cues
• The task requires sensing tactile differences in materials or surfaces
• The task involves perceiving smells or tastes for quality or safety
• The task requires integrating multiple sensory inputs for decision-making
exclusion_rules:
• The task relies entirely on instruments or sensors instead of human senses
• The user performs work where sensory input is irrelevant
• The task involves only data or abstract reasoning
• The user is operating equipment that automates sensory detection
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when detection is done by instruments or sensors rather than human senses.

confusions.boundary_rule: Sensory-processing is perceiving stimuli. Manual dexterity is acting on them.
confusions.example_task: Feel for fabric texture differences while cutting patterns accurately.
confusions.expected_labels: Sensory-processing abilities; Manual dexterity, endurance and precision

confusions.boundary_rule: Sensory-processing can aid inspection, but quality control is standards-based.
confusions.example_task: Detect off-smells in food products during quality checks.

confusions.boundary_rule: Sensory-processing is a perceptual ability. Dependability is a work trait.
confusions.example_task: Notice subtle colour changes in product samples and record them carefully.
confusions.expected_labels: Sensory-processing abilities; Dependability and attention to detail

examples.task_text: Detect colour variations in fabric dye lots before production approval.
Identify abnormal sounds from a production machine during routine checks.
Use a digital scanner to check product barcodes.
